content: वेधः .²1 Penetrating, piercing, perforation. .²2 Wounding, a wound. .²3 A hole, an excavation. .²4 The depth (of an excavation). .²5 A particular measure of time. .²6 The ninth part of a {%Paridhi%}; परिधिनवमभागः शूकधान्येषु वेधः <ls>Līlā.</ls> .²7 Fixing the position of the sun, planets or the stars. .²8 Disturbance.
